_note: EXTRACTION, REMOTE: the courier ambush. Written by Jessica 2026-10-14 on his 'make them unique', over Eliza's
remote copy of 02a. Structure unchanged (pickup, hold, deliver; 09a's wave plumbing; sizes and styles are
ELIZA'S PLACEHOLDER escalation). What is new is the cause: 02a's crew come back for what they were run off;
here a clinic's courier was jumped, and lifting the canister wakes its tracker, which is what brings the
people who did it. The remote client can only see the tracker, which is why they can warn you.
No message boxes (action type, his 2026-10-08 ruling). The pickup carries no journal on purpose: the hold's
stage is set the same instant and the log shows only the newest line.
MODELS NOT ON THE APPROVED LIST, his eye first: BioHazardCanister_01 (vanilla MoveableStatic, STANDS, about
0.5 m, so small on the ground) as the canister; Beacon01 (vanilla outpost beacon, STANDS, 4.9 m) as the courier
pickup beacon. Both measured with gen_inspect bounds 2026-10-14.

place._theme: No natural or cave sites: his 09a ruling 2026-10-12 once waves spawn close behind the player, and the base's own exclusions.
place._remote: REMOTE (place.remote), made 2026-10-14 by Eliza from 02a's structure on his plan; story and words rewritten by Jessica the same morning, so nothing here is a placeholder any more. LocTypeTest excluded as the remote base does.

prose.name: Extraction: Culture Canister on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A clinic's courier was jumped at the <Place> and had to drop a canister of vaccine cultures. Whoever jumped her left it where it fell, which looks a lot like bait.

say: That's its tracker back on. I can see it from here.
Which means they can too. Get ready.
beats._say: On the pickup because a beat's say plays when its stage is SET, and wave 1 spawns on this stage (Eliza's move on 02a, 2026-10-12). The speaker is off-world and can only see the tracker, so the warning is about the tracker.
beats.objective: Recover the culture canister at the <Place>
beats.name: Dropped Culture Canister

beats._at: The map marker, his 2026-10-27 ruling off his play: "The defend marker is at a random point" on RETravelB1LocRef, a travel-ring marker that can sit anywhere round the POI. The hold reuses the quest's own map-marker alias (his "reuse the map marker alias"), since a second alias on the same reference fails the contention check.
beats.journal: Lifting the canister woke its tracker, and the people who jumped the courier came straight for it. I have to deal with them before I can get it out.

beats.objective: Leave the canister at the courier beacon
beats.journal: I got the clinic's vaccine cultures out of the <Place> past the people who jumped their courier, and left them at the courier beacon for collection.
beats.name: Courier Pickup Beacon
say: That's it, we've got it. There's a colony waiting on those cultures.

broadcast: Our courier was jumped on her way back and had to drop a canister of vaccine cultures.
It's still out there. Get it to the courier beacon before anyone else does.
Whoever jumped her didn't take it, and that worries me. I think they're waiting to see who comes for it.
_speech: Radio rules: no names, no places. Voice is ElevenLabs' 'Sarah, Mature, Reassuring, Confident', NOT yet heard in game (voices.md); his ear decides.
_wording: 2026-10-27, his catch: 'They may still be watching for it.' delivered badly on its own (each list item is its own audio line). Reworded whole: every radio line is a complete thought, the bait is said once with its reason, and the pickup line answers it. Then his 'I know i'll be paid' (on Seismic Sensors, same morning): the pay promise in line two is gone.
